summary: Full stack tested for Collage Studio (photo collage app, IT). Backend: 12/12 pytest tests passed - photos CRUD, upload/serve/delete, samples import + idempotency, projects CRUD, export JPG (50x70 @150 and @300 DPI dimensions verified via formula round(cm/2.54*dpi)), PDF and PNG exports validated. Frontend: Studio loads in Italian with sample photos auto-imported, 4-cell Griglia 2x2 fully filled on 50x70 vertical (no empty cells). All mandated data-testids present across Formato/Cornice/Cella tabs (frame-color-*, passepartout-toggle, layout-grid-option-2/3/4/6/9, cell-item-*, filter-*, remove-cell-photo). Save project, Export menu with JPG/PDF/PNG buttons all work; JPG download succeeded (Nuovo_collage.jpg). Vista Parete modal renders wall preview successfully; Specifiche dialog opens with format/DPI info. Orientation switch updates canvas aspect ratio correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend uses in-process caches (_img_cache, _bytes_cache) with no size limit - risk of memory growth for long-running processes; consider LRU or TTL cache.
PhotoOut model requires storage_path etc., but list_photos returns docs from Mongo directly; works because projection excludes _id. Fine.
asyncio.to_thread only used in /api/file but not in /api/export or /api/upload where put_object/get_object are sync requests calls inside async handlers - can block the event loop under load.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py covers all core endpoints incl. export dimension check. Frontend verified via Playwright end-to-end including download. No blocking issues found.
